name: buddy
description: Buddy — a little computer companion. iOS app + desktop app. Talks on your phone, sees and does on your computer.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @buddy/protocol && npm run build -w @buddy/core && npm run build -w @buddy/companion && npm run build -w @buddy/host
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @buddy/host
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core apps/host apps/desktop --pretty && npm run typecheck -w @buddy/companion
